Create the initial project knowledge base for Doninha. Read the skill `doninha-project-research` to understand how to create the `.doninha/docs/codebase/` files — `OVERVIEW.md` (the repo's business role, nicknames/status, cross-repo relations and module map), the conditional `modules/<slug>.md` capability docs, and the eight technical files — which together are the single source of project information, and how to maintain `DONINHA.md`, which holds only the repos index and configuration/policies — no project synthesis.
